Hi Sarah —

Thanks for applying to the Platform Reliability role — really enjoyed your profile. Would love to schedule a 25-minute intro phone screen with our hiring manager. Rather than back-and-forth slot swaps, we’re trying a short ‘timebank’ handshake: could you share your regular availability windows for the next two weeks (3–4 blocks of recurring windows that work for you, e.g., Tue/Wed mornings PST), or alternatively pick any one of these three candidate-friendly slots in my calendar?

Option A: Wed 11/18, 10:00–10:25 AM PST
Option B: Thu 11/19, 2:30–2:55 PM PST
Option C: Mon 11/23, 4:00–4:25 PM PST

If none work, tell me a daily window that you typically keep open and we’ll adapt. My goal is to find a time that minimizes re-scheduling.

Also, feel free to attach your most recent resume (PDF) if you have it handy. I’ll loop in Hannah (hiring manager) once we lock a slot.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Senior Recruiter | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0198
